description: Resilient Strategies Guide for Water Utilities is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Creating Resilient Water Utilities Program. This guide assists drinking water, wastewater, and storm water utilities in developing climate adaptation plans that address their highest priorities. Utilities input key information such as location, system type, planning priorities, and critical assets. Based on the submitted information, the guide outputs potential adaptation strategies to address the utility’s specific needs. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
